evidence: Synthetic geometry supervised denoising and untrained energy-model mathematical audit; not molecular diffusion or calibrated MLIP

data.units: arbitrary length; all energy audit values arbitrary
data.families: planar random ellipses for train/validation/test; sinusoidally warped cycles OOD only
data.noise_convention: Gaussian node noise minus per-graph centroid noise
data.topology: known labeled eight-node cycle, no molecular bonds or species in denoising
data.partition_rule: independent fixed generator seeds; each clean shape appears once, no augmented copies across partitions

training.selection: minimum validation loss epoch only; test and OOD never select checkpoints
training.coordinate_updates: subtract graph-mean update, preserving the input centroid
training.no_diffusion_claim: no learned time-dependent score, forward schedule or reverse sampling chain

source_repairs_reviewed_only: cutoff gates entire messages and vector updates
fixed total-charge projection; neutral origin invariance
one-step denoising training and disjoint saved partitions
limitations: Source and reviewed potential weights remain untrained; forces cannot be interpreted as accurate chemistry
Charge constraint repairs conservation and origin covariance, not local charge accuracy
Reflection covariance requires rotating/reflection-transforming external field jointly
Cycle denoiser assumes ordered cycle adjacency; arbitrary relabeling requires relabeling graph edges
Centering noise removes centroid recovery difficulty and limits the synthetic task
PCA baseline knows planarity; OOD warped shapes test sensitivity to that prior
Three training seeds on one fixed synthetic dataset do not establish generalization confidence

archived_source_snapshot.reason: Original successful pilot before optional graph-adjacency API extension; final model will expose explicit permutation-consistent graph input
